scientific_integrity: One exact all-parameter proof using acyclic-orientation Hasse covers, orientation-run decomposition and a binomial sign-change lemma; standalone finite checker is an independent cross-check, not a proof of infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Classifies degree excess at torus-fixed points, not full singular strata; degree excess is not local class-group rank or embedding dimension. Originality is bounded by inspected literature and mathematical-record search, not a uniqueness certificate.
title: Fan graphical zonotopes have a rational local-degree spectrum
